'''NYC player with Japanese Vader''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2001 New York City Reflections II Booster Draft tournament]] on 10 February 2001 with Jabba's Palace deck with Gailid and Japanese Vader, according to Brian Terwilliger's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1728">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-13-twigg-the-nyc-reflections-2-sealedd1728/ twigg-the-nyc-reflections-2-sealed], DeckTech (Brian "twigg" Terwilliger, 13 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-13-twigg-the-nyc-reflections-2-sealedd1728/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
